facts.fact: APS reports that on Thursday 9 April 2026 the minister of communication, telecommunications and digital affairs installed satellite kits at three institutions in Bignona department under the government's universal connectivity policy: two vocational training centres, at Albadar and Abéné, given very-high-speed satellite connections, and the Bignona town hall, which is also to benefit.
facts.system: kits satellitaires de la connectivité universelle (New Deal technologique)

facts.fact: One town hall, that of the commune of Bignona, is among the three institutions given a satellite kit by the minister on 9 April 2026, the other two being vocational training centres; no national count of town halls connected is given.
facts.system: kits satellitaires de la connectivité universelle (New Deal technologique)

facts.fact: The mayor of Bignona said on 9 April 2026 that with the satellite link the municipal services, civil status first, should perform better, the commune having long been digitally cut off; no system the staff work in over the link is named.
facts.system: kits satellitaires de la connectivité universelle (New Deal technologique)

facts.fact: The satellite kit for the Bignona town hall was installed by the minister of communication, telecommunications and digital affairs himself on 9 April 2026, under the government's universal connectivity policy within the New Deal technologique; who pays the subscription is not stated.
facts.system: kits satellitaires de la connectivité universelle (New Deal technologique)

facts.fact: On 9 April 2026 the minister installed satellite broadband kits at three institutions in Bignona department, the Bignona town hall among them, and asked the departmental council to draw up a territorial digital plan identifying uncovered zones and priority establishments.
facts.system: kits satellitaires de la connectivité universelle (New Deal technologique)
